# 1.4. Download data from github {.unnumbered}

1.  Go to <https://download-directory.github.io>

<img src="https://gdsl-ul.github.io/gds/img/download1.png" width="70%"/>

2.  Go to the folder you need for your Lab. For example copy: <https://github.com/dataandcrowd/GISCI343/tree/main/pedestrians>

<img src="https://gdsl-ul.github.io/gds/img/download2.png" width="60%"/>

3.  Paste it in the green box... give it a few minutes

4.  Check your downloads file and unzip

<img src="https://gdsl-ul.github.io/gds/img/download3.png" width="60%"/>
